# Salesforce Developers
> Salesforce’s developer platform documentation for building apps, automations, integrations, and AI-powered experiences on Force.com and related products.

This site provides official technical documentation for Salesforce platform development, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, APIs, integrations, mobile SDKs, DevOps tooling, and agentic AI capabilities across the Salesforce ecosystem.

## Developer Home
- [Salesforce Developers](https://developer.salesforce.com/): Main developer portal for platform docs, tools, APIs, SDKs, and learning resources.
- [Documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs): Entry point to Salesforce technical documentation across products and developer workflows.
- [Get Started](https://developer.salesforce.com/get-started): Onboarding resources for new Salesforce developers and platform builders.
- [Developer Centers](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers): Product-focused hubs for Salesforce platform, APIs, mobile, and AI development.
- [Trailblazer Community](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/trailblazer-community): Community forum and collaboration space for Salesforce developers and architects.

## Platform Development
- [Platform Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform): Overview of core Salesforce platform development concepts, tools, and architecture.
- [Apex Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/): Reference and guides for Apex language, triggers, classes, and testing.
- [SOQL and SOSL Reference](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.soql_sosl.meta/soql_sosl/): Query language reference for retrieving and searching Salesforce data.
- [Lightning Web Components Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc): Build modern UI components using the Lightning Web Components programming model.
- [Visualforce Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.pages.meta/pages/): Legacy UI framework documentation for custom Salesforce page development.
- [Platform Events Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.platform_events.meta/platform_events/): Event-driven architecture documentation for publishing and subscribing to platform events.

## APIs and Integration
- [Salesforce APIs](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/apis): Central hub for REST, SOAP, Bulk, Metadata, and streaming APIs.
- [REST API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/): Reference for accessing Salesforce data and metadata through REST endpoints.
- [SOAP API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api.meta/api/): Enterprise and Partner SOAP API reference for data operations and integration.
- [Bulk API 2.0 and Bulk API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_asynch.meta/api_asynch/): High-volume data ingest and extraction APIs for asynchronous processing.
- [Metadata API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/): Programmatic deployment and retrieval of Salesforce metadata and configuration.
- [Pub/Sub API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api): gRPC-based event bus API for platform events and change data capture.
- [Connect REST API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.chatterapi.meta/chatterapi/): REST resources for feeds, files, topics, and collaboration features.

## Lightning Experience and UI
- [Lightning Web Components](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/component-library/documentation/en/lwc): Component model documentation and examples for Lightning Web Components.
- [Lightning Component Library](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/component-library/overview/components): Browse base components, examples, and usage guidance for Lightning UI development.
- [Lightning Design System](https://www.lightningdesignsystem.com/): Design system, patterns, tokens, and accessibility guidance for Salesforce interfaces.
- [Aura Components Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.lightning.meta/lightning/): Documentation for the Aura component framework used in Lightning Experience.
- [UI API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.uiapi.meta/uiapi/): APIs for metadata-aware UI data access and record operations.
- [GraphQL API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/graphql): GraphQL access to Salesforce data and UI API resources.

## CLI, DX, and DevOps
- [Salesforce CLI](https://developer.salesforce.com/tools/salesforcecli): Official command-line tools for org management, development, and deployment automation.
- [Salesforce DX Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.sfdx_dev.meta/sfdx_dev/): Source-driven development, scratch orgs, packaging, and team collaboration workflows.
- [Unlocked Packages](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.pkg2_dev.meta/pkg2_dev/): Second-generation packaging documentation for modular application development and release management.
- [DevOps Center](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/devops-center): Guided change and release management for Salesforce teams using source control.
- [Code Builder](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/code-builder): Browser-based development environment for Salesforce coding and metadata workflows.
- [VS Code Extensions](https://developer.salesforce.com/tools/vscode/): Salesforce extensions for Visual Studio Code supporting Apex, LWC, and org operations.

## Agentforce and AI Development
- [Agentforce Developer Center](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/agentforce): Hub for building, extending, and deploying Agentforce agents and AI experiences.
- [Agentforce Documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/einstein/genai): Technical docs for generative AI, agents, prompts, and grounding on Salesforce.
- [Prompt Builder](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/einstein/genai/guide/prompt-builder.html): Create, test, and manage reusable prompts for Salesforce AI workflows.
- [Einstein Copilot Studio](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/einstein/genai/guide/copilot-studio.html): Configure custom copilot actions, topics, and conversational AI behaviors.
- [Data Cloud for Developers](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/data): Developer documentation for Data Cloud ingestion, modeling, and activation.
- [MuleSoft for Agentforce](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/einstein/genai/guide/mulesoft-agentforce.html): Use MuleSoft integrations and actions to extend agent capabilities.

## Mobile and SDKs
- [Mobile SDK Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/mobile-sdk): Build native and hybrid mobile apps connected to Salesforce data and identity.
- [Android Mobile SDK](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/mobile-sdk/guide/android-native.html): Native Android development guidance using Salesforce Mobile SDK components.
- [iOS Mobile SDK](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/mobile-sdk/guide/ios-native.html): Native iOS development guidance for secure Salesforce-connected mobile applications.
- [Hybrid App Development](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/mobile-sdk/guide/hybrid-about.html): Cordova-based hybrid mobile app development with Salesforce Mobile SDK.
- [Mobile Publisher](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.mobile_sdk.meta/mobile_sdk/publisher_overview.htm): Package and distribute branded Salesforce mobile applications for end users.

## Commerce, Experience, and Industry APIs
- [Commerce Developer Center](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/commerce): Developer resources for B2C Commerce, headless commerce, and storefront integrations.
- [B2C Commerce Developer Docs](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce): Technical documentation for Salesforce Commerce development and APIs.
- [Experience Cloud Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.exp_cloud_dev.meta/exp_cloud_dev/): Build custom digital experiences, portals, and community extensions.
- [Marketing Cloud Developer Center](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/marketing-cloud): APIs, SDKs, and integration resources for Marketing Cloud development.
- [MuleSoft Developer Center](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/mulesoft): Integration platform resources for APIs, connectors, and automation development.
- [Tableau Developer Program](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/tableau): Developer resources for analytics embedding, extensions, and Tableau APIs.

## Learning and Release Resources
- [Release Notes](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=release-notes.salesforce_release_notes.htm&type=5): Official Salesforce release notes covering platform features, changes, and deprecations.
- [Developer Blog](https://developer.salesforce.com/blogs): Articles, announcements, tutorials, and best practices from Salesforce engineering teams.
- [Sample Apps and Code](https://developer.salesforce.com/sample-apps): Example applications demonstrating Salesforce platform patterns and integrations.
- [Code Samples on GitHub](https://github.com/forcedotcom): Open-source repositories, examples, and tooling maintained by Salesforce developer teams.
- [Trailhead for Developers](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/users/strailhead/trailmixes/prepare-for-your-salesforce-platform-developer-i-credential): Guided learning paths for Salesforce platform development skills and certification preparation.
- [Events and Webinars](https://developer.salesforce.com/events): Developer-focused events, webinars, and conference sessions from Salesforce.
